record.available: For an abelian variety over a characteristic-zero nonarchimedean local field, the compact rational-points group is dual to H^1 of the dual abelian variety. It has an open finite-index additive integer-ring subgroup; the duality is compatible with the finite Kummer and Weil pairings.
record.needed: For the actual elliptic E/Q_v, derived Kummer has full degree-zero torsion and its finite Kummer image is selfannihilating. The compact quotient has rank1 at2 and vanishes at v not2.
record.argument: Use the principal polarization and finite Kummer compatibility. Local analytic structure gives rank one for the 2-primary completion at v=2 and rank zero at other finite places. The dual of H1(Qv,E)[2^n] is E(Qv)/2^n; the discrete transition is multiplication by2. Thus the Tate module is dual to E(Qv) tensor Q2/Z2, giving the stated compact quotient. The full compact E(Qv) is dual to the full H1(Qv,E), not to this Tate module.
record.boundary: This source applies to finite places only. The real Kummer complex and minus-line calculation are separately retained.

record.argument: Apply finite local duality to E[2^n], using the elliptic Weil self-duality. Pass to the adjoint compact/discrete systems by proof15. This preserves the maps and identifies each finite-place H2 length with g_v.
